mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, min_score AS minScore, max_score AS maxScore, annual_rate AS annualRate, tier_label AS tierLabel, remark, enabled, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM loan_pricing_tier WHERE enabled = 1 AND #{score} BETWEEN min_score AND max_score AND (product_id = #{productId} OR product_id IS NULL) ORDER BY (product_id IS NULL) ASC, min_score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, product_id AS productId, min_score AS minScore, max_score AS maxScore, annual_rate AS annualRate, tier_label AS tierLabel, remark, enabled, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM loan_pricing_tier ORDER BY (product_id IS NULL) ASC, min_score DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_pricing_tier (product_id, min_score, max_score, annual_rate, tier_label, remark, enabled) VALUES (#{productId}, #{minScore}, #{maxScore}, #{annualRate}, #{tierLabel}, #{remark}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE loan_pricing_tier SET product_id = #{productId}, min_score = #{minScore}, max_score = #{maxScore}, annual_rate = #{annualRate}, tier_label = #{tierLabel}, remark = #{remark}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
